facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2025-0144 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 1 September 2025 as a scheduled change under change assurance; no event precedes it in the record. The change assurance record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the material unwanted event control named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
